description:
Convert between a nominal annual rate (APR) and an effective annual rate (APY/EAR).

Discrete uses periods_per_year (e.g. 12 = monthly); continuous ignores it
(EAR = e^nominal - 1; nominal = ln(1 + EAR)).

periods_per_year.description: Compounding periods per year, e.g. 12 for monthly (365 = daily is the finest discrete step; use compounding='continuous' for the limit).

rate.description: The annual rate to convert (nominal or effective, per direction) as a decimal, e.g. 0.05 for 5%.

name: convert_rate

outputSchema.description: Result of a nominal<->effective annual rate conversion.

compounding.description: Compounding convention used for the conversion.

converted_rate.description: The resulting rate, as a decimal.

input_rate.description: The rate provided, as a decimal.

title: Nominal / Effective Rate Conversion
